hypotheses.statement: Explicit actuation improves correct route selection.
hypotheses.predicted_behavior: The explicit variant delegates delegate-worthy work without overdelegating bounded direct work.
hypotheses.falsification_signal: The direction reverses or explicit wording produces no pre-ratified improvement under complete paired cells.

hypotheses.statement: Contiguous role-to-tool mapping is more reliable than separated mapping.
hypotheses.predicted_behavior: The adjacent variant has fewer mixed route outcomes than the separated variant.
hypotheses.falsification_signal: The separated variant is more stable under complete paired cells.

hypotheses.statement: Ambiguous doctrine produces seed-sensitive route selection.
hypotheses.predicted_behavior: The separated variant produces mixed results that contract under explicit wording.
hypotheses.falsification_signal: Ambiguity does not increase mixed cells under the pre-ratified comparison.
